name: ChatDev 2.0 (DevAll)
description: Zero-code multi-agent platform where agent teams are defined by configuration and launched from a web console.
whatItDoes: Users pick or define a multi-agent workflow, upload any input files and enter a request such as a data visualisation or a small game. The earlier virtual software company version lives on in a legacy branch.
howItWorks: A Python backend server executes configured agent workflows and a Vue front end provides the console with a Launch tab. It can also run through Docker Compose or be called by an OpenClaw instance through a skill.

requirements.name: LLM API key
requirements.description: Stored in a .env file in the project root
